#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <memory>

#define MOZ_ALWAYS_INLINE inline
#define MOZ_ASSERT(condition) ((void)0)

struct JSFunction;
struct JSContext;
struct JSObject {
  template<class T> T& as() { return static_cast<T&>(*this); }
};
struct Value { JSObject* object = nullptr; };
Value UndefinedValue() { return {}; }
Value ObjectValue(JSObject& value) { return {&value}; }
using Native = bool (*)(JSContext*, unsigned, Value*);
struct PropertyName {};
template<class T> struct Handle {
  T value;
  Handle(T input) : value(input) {}
};
using HandleObject = JSObject*;
struct MutableHandleObject {
  JSObject** value;
  void set(JSObject* object) { *value = object; }
  explicit operator bool() const { return *value != nullptr; }
  JSObject* operator->() const { return *value; }
  JSObject* get() const { return *value; }
};
namespace gc { enum class AllocKind { FUNCTION_EXTENDED }; }
constexpr int GenericObject = 0;
constexpr int ResolveFunctionSlot_Promise = 0;
constexpr int ResolveFunctionSlot_RejectFunction = 1;
constexpr int RejectFunctionSlot_Promise = 0;
constexpr int RejectFunctionSlot_ResolveFunction = 1;
struct JSFunction : JSObject {
  Native native = nullptr;
  Value slots[2];
  Native maybeNative() const { return native; }
  void initExtendedSlot(int index, Value value) { slots[index] = value; }
  void setExtendedSlot(int index, Value value) { slots[index] = value; }
};
struct JSContext {
  struct Names { PropertyName* empty_ = nullptr; } names_value;
  std::unique_ptr<JSFunction> objects[2];
  int allocations = 0, attempts = 0, fail_at = 0;
  bool exception = false;
  Names& names() { return names_value; }
};
bool ResolvePromiseFunction(JSContext*, unsigned, Value*) { return true; }
bool RejectPromiseFunction(JSContext*, unsigned, Value*) { return true; }
JSFunction* GetRejectFunctionFromResolve(JSFunction* value) {
  return &value->slots[ResolveFunctionSlot_RejectFunction].object->as<JSFunction>();
}
JSFunction* GetResolveFunctionFromReject(JSFunction* value) {
  return &value->slots[RejectFunctionSlot_ResolveFunction].object->as<JSFunction>();
}
JSFunction* NewNativeFunction(JSContext* cx, Native native, int, Handle<PropertyName*>,
                              gc::AllocKind, int) {
  if (++cx->attempts == cx->fail_at) { cx->exception = true; return nullptr; }
  if (cx->allocations == 2) { cx->exception = true; return nullptr; }
  auto& object = cx->objects[cx->allocations++];
  object = std::make_unique<JSFunction>();
  object->native = native;
  return object.get();
}
struct Hooks {
  bool (*beforeCapturedAllocate)(JSContext*, void**);
  void (*allocationFailed)(void*);
  void (*capturedCreated)(JSContext*, JSObject*, void*);
};
static JSContext* activationPromiseContext = nullptr;
static Hooks* activationPromiseHooks = nullptr;
static int limit = 0, admitted = 0, created = 0, failed = 0;
static int tokens[2];
bool before(JSContext* cx, void** output) {
  if (admitted >= limit) { cx->exception = true; return false; }
  *output = &tokens[admitted++]; return true;
}
void allocation_failed(void*) { ++failed; }
void captured_created(JSContext*, JSObject*, void*) { ++created; }

/* LSF_SETTLE_TARGET */
/* LSF_CREATE_TARGET */

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
  if (argc != 2) return 2;
  JSContext cx;
  Hooks hooks{before, allocation_failed, captured_created};
  activationPromiseContext = &cx;
  activationPromiseHooks = std::strcmp(argv[1], "unselected") ? &hooks : nullptr;
  limit = !std::strcmp(argv[1], "capacity") ? 1 : 2;
  if (!std::strcmp(argv[1], "first-oom")) cx.fail_at = 1;
  if (!std::strcmp(argv[1], "second-oom")) cx.fail_at = 2;
  JSObject promise;
  JSObject* resolve = nullptr;
  JSObject* reject = nullptr;
  const bool result = CreateResolvingFunctions(&cx, &promise, {&resolve}, {&reject});
  bool slots_cleared = false;
  if (result && resolve && reject) {
    SetAlreadyResolvedResolutionFunction(&resolve->as<JSFunction>());
    auto& a = resolve->as<JSFunction>(); auto& b = reject->as<JSFunction>();
    slots_cleared = !a.slots[0].object && !a.slots[1].object &&
                    !b.slots[0].object && !b.slots[1].object;
  }
  std::printf("{\"case\":\"%s\",\"result\":%s,\"exception\":%s,"
              "\"allocations\":%d,\"attempts\":%d,\"admitted\":%d,"
              "\"created\":%d,\"failed\":%d,\"resolvePresent\":%s,"
              "\"rejectPresent\":%s,\"slotsCleared\":%s,\"engineQualified\":false}\n",
              argv[1], result ? "true" : "false", cx.exception ? "true" : "false",
              cx.allocations, cx.attempts, admitted, created, failed,
              resolve ? "true" : "false", reject ? "true" : "false",
              slots_cleared ? "true" : "false");
  return 0;
}
